description: DEPARTEMENT DE LA SAVOIE: road datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by DEPARTEMENT DE LA SAVOIE. Coverage: DEPARTEMENT DE LA SAVOIE. The listing groups 4 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about road; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Stations de comptage routier de la Savoie; Stations de comptage routier de la Savoie 2023; Stations de comptage routier de la Savoie 2024; Réseau routier départemental de la Savoie. Formats seen: KML. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
